topic: KNOWN DEFECT C1: Huy tu approved KHONG hoan balance - mat tien thuc
statement: Theo tai lieu `admin - invoices and payment methods` Section: Journey - Huy 1 yeu cau thanh toan, `invoicing payment - payout request journey` Section: C2 - Huy khi da o approved, va `known issues edge cases` Section: C1 (3 tai lieu doc lap dong thuan), khi mot Invoice DA o trang thai approved (Ops da duyet nhung chua chi tien thuc) bi doi sang cancel, balance cua affiliate KHONG duoc hoan lai tu dong - co che hoan balance chi ap dung cho dung nhanh chuyen tu pending -> cancel. He qua: affiliate vua khong nhan duoc tien vua khong lay lai duoc balance, tru khi Ops tu tay cong lai balance thu cong qua man hinh/form User. Day la hanh vi SAI dang ton tai (known defect), KHONG phai expected result - giu nguyen OBSERVED_CURRENT, khong duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED.
